# Arcana Scholastica: Minor Illusion

To cast *Minor Illusion* is to dance upon the precipice of truth. Shaping the Weave for this cantrip feels like plucking invisible, silver gossamer; it is a delicate, vibrating tension against the fingertips, requiring a mind that can envision what is not there.

The manifestation is a "hollow truth"—a static image or phantom sound born of refracted aether. It possesses no weight or warmth, yet it mimics reality with startling fidelity, shimmering into existence like heat haze on a summer road. It is the art of the lie given visual form.

### The Legend of the Silenced Apprentice
Chroniclers trace this magic to Kaelen of the Low-Ward, a mute apprentice who faced execution for a crime he did not commit. Lacking a voice to plead his innocence, he reached into the ambient magic and projected a silent image of the true thief. The court was so captivated by the shimmering phantom that Kaelen walked free, leaving behind the first recorded instance of a thought made manifest without substance.
